mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, display_seq AS displaySeq FROM pev_record ORDER BY parent_id desc, display_seq

select section_id as sectionId, id, parent_id as parentId, class_type as classType, control_type as controlType, masking_type as maskingType, content, "desc" from pev_record_format where record_id = #{recordDetailType} and mdfm_id = #{mdfmId} and mdfm_fom_seq = #{mdfmFomSeq} order by section_id, id, parent_id
mapper.insert:
insert into pev_record_format (record_id, mdfm_id, mdfm_fom_seq, section_id, id, parent_id, class_type, control_type, masking_type, content, "desc", load_dtm) values
(#{item.recordId}, #{item.mdfmId}, #{item.mdfmFomSeq}, #{item.sectionId}, #{item.id}, #{item.parentId}, #{item.classType}, #{item.controlType}, #{item.maskingType}, #{item.content}, #{item.desc}, #{item.loadDtm})
on conflict (record_id, mdfm_id, mdfm_fom_seq, section_id, id, parent_id) do update set class_type = excluded.class_type, control_type = excluded.control_type, masking_type = excluded.masking_type, content = excluded.content, "desc" = excluded."desc", load_dtm = excluded.load_dtm
